lyrics:
[Intro: arpeggiated synth bass, disco hi-hat, string swell]

[Verse 1: dramatic low female voice]
They said wait until it's dark
They said glitter needs a night
I have waited long enough
Hang it up, turn on the light

[Chorus: full Italo-disco groove, long falling melody]
Disco at noon
Mirrorball in the daylight
Diamonds on the water, shadows on the wall
Sequins in the sun and nowhere to be at all
I don't need the moon
Disco at noon

[Verse 2: voice closer, guitar chopping]
I was young, I stayed out late
Now I'm up before the heat
Same two feet, same silver shoes
Different hour, same old beat

[Chorus: full Italo-disco groove, long falling melody]
Disco at noon
Mirrorball in the daylight
Diamonds on the water, shadows on the wall
Sequins in the sun and nowhere to be at all
I don't need the moon
Disco at noon

[Instrumental: synth solo over the arpeggio]

[Bridge: beat thins, voice and strings]
Why save it? Why save it?
The light is here. I'm here.

[Final Chorus: everything in, backing voices answering]
Disco at noon
Mirrorball in the daylight
Diamonds on the water, shadows on the wall
Sequins in the sun and nowhere to be at all
I don't need the moon
Disco at noon

[Outro: arpeggio and strings fade]
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 112 BPM, 4/4, C minor. A cool, gliding Italo-disco pulse, glamorous and a little melancholy.

VOICE: Female, low, rich and androgynous, sung with drama and long held notes that fall at the ends of phrases. Two backing voices answer in the last chorus.

INSTRUMENTS: A sixteenth-note arpeggiated analogue synth bass, a steady disco kick with an open hi-hat on the off-beat, a crisp snare with a little gated reverb, lush string-machine chords, a clean chopped rhythm guitar, a bright synth solo, electric toms in the fills.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro, arpeggio and strings. 0:16 Verse 1. 0:44 Chorus 1. 1:12 Verse 2. 1:40 Chorus 2. 2:08 Synth solo. 2:24 Bridge. 2:38 Final chorus. 3:04 Outro fade, ends 3:14.

PRODUCTION & MIX: A 2020 revival of 1983 Italo-disco: glossy, wide and analogue-sounding, bass arpeggio in front, voice with a plate reverb.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: The long falling line 'nowhere to be at all' at 1:02.

STATION FIT: Noon exactly. Glamour in daylight, at an easy 112 BPM that suits a lunch crowd.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Defiant, dazzling, wistful, free.
